g.text: DiffBind log2FC (mut / ctrl). The model predicts ATAC down, H3K27ac down, H3K27me3 up, H2AK119ub up.
Shift is the Hodges-Lehmann location shift, neuronal minus other; r is the rank-biserial correlation.
Chromatin mark change in BAP1-KO: neuronal against other genes
